body_markdown:
## Built for kids, loved
by parents.


MyPhone is designed for parents who want to delay smartphones while keeping kids connected.


##### Trusted Circle


Only approved family members and friends can call or be called.


##### Party Line


Kids can chat with multiple friends or family members on the same call.


##### Quiet Hours


Schedule phone-free time during homework, dinner, or bedtime.


##### Call Log


Parents can view call activity online at any time.


##### Address-Based 911


Emergency responders receive your registered address, and parents can receive text and email alerts if 911 is called.


##### Voicemail


Built-in answering machine saves messages from loved ones.
